findings.text: No assertion covers the extracted deep-link paths in useRouting.js: parseURL (company/jobDetail/universal/404 cases), the pendingDetail resolution effect (company slug found sets selCo and fromView 'directory'; unknown slug sets view '404'), or the popstate handler (onPop). useRouting.test.jsx only checks the '/stuttgart' home init, nav('directory') and goTo('co-2','directory'), so a regression in any deep-link or back/forward behavior would still pass.

findings.ac: AC2: filters, search queries, modals identical
findings.text: No test exercises filtering, search (q/inputQ debounce, fCo/fJo memos in App.jsx), or modals. The only filter-related assertion is that resetFilters mock is called on nav('directory'); the reset function now hoisted above useRouting in App.jsx and passed in is never tested for what it clears. These blocks are largely untouched, so this is a watch item.

useEcosystemData.test.jsx covers only the happy path with one matching region (loading false, companies length 1, dataSource 'supabase'). Untested: mock fallback when isConfigured is false, catch-path mock fallback with region 'Stuttgart', landing branch (no matching region, fetchCompanies() all), single-region window.location.href redirect (now keyed on parseURL().view instead of the live view state), short region-name derivation, and sectorDefs/jobFuncDefs/activeRegion/allRegions population (never asserted).

findings.ac: AC1: npm run build completes with zero errors
findings.text: No test, CI step, or recorded output proves the build: .github/workflows holds only sync-labels-to-project.yml, and the vitest tests import the hooks directly and never import App.jsx or run vite build. A broken import or export in App.jsx (useEcosystemData.js, useRouting.js named/default imports) would pass all tests.

No assertion, benchmark or measurement supports this. One structural change is untested: nav's useCallback now depends on resetFilters, and App.jsx passes a fresh 'reset' closure each render, so nav is recreated every render (previously deps were [regionSlug, view]). Likely harmless as nothing is memoized on nav, but it is unverified.
